title.rendered: Top Portable Office Cabins in North Delhi for Site Managers & Field Professionals

content.rendered:
Looking for portable office cabins in North Delhi? SAMAN builds professional office cabins for project teams, field staff and administrators across Rohini, Pitampura, Civil Lines, Shalimar Bagh and Model Town. Each cabin is built new and delivered ready to use.

Why North Delhi businesses choose portable office cabins

Project and field teams in North Delhi need a proper workspace on the ground — for planning, documentation and meetings — that installs fast and moves when the work moves.

  • Quick to install for project and field teams across North Delhi.
  • Professional interiors for planning, document storage and meetings.
  • Insulated, air-conditioning-ready build for year-round comfort.
  • Easy to relocate as project phases or locations change.

Where portable office cabins work in North Delhi

  • On-ground project and field offices for infrastructure and development work in Rohini.
  • Administrative and document-management cabins for teams in Civil Lines.
  • Temporary control rooms for residential and institutional projects in Pitampura.
  • Meeting and coordination cabins for field staff across North Delhi.

What a SAMAN portable office cabin includes

Every cabin is built new to your floor plan at our own plant, so you control the size, the layout and the finish. Common footprints are 10×10 ft, 20×8 ft, 20×10 ft and 40×10 ft, used on their own or joined into multi-room layouts with private cabins, a meeting room and a washroom.

  • Structure: IS 2062 structural steel (MS) frame for strength and a long service life.
  • Walls and roof: insulated panels (around 50 mm) that keep the interior cooler in summer and cut outside noise.
  • Flooring: vitrified, ceramic or vinyl flooring chosen to suit the use.
  • Electricals: concealed wiring with switchboards, lighting, fan and air-conditioning points ready to connect.
  • Openings: powder-coated doors and windows, lockable, with optional grilles.
  • Add-ons: partitions, a pantry, a toilet, ramps, extra windows and custom branding in your colours.

Need a specific layout? Tell us how your team in North Delhi works and we design the cabin around it — a single workspace, a reception plus cabins, or a larger multi-room office.

Delivery and installation in North Delhi

Each cabin is manufactured at our Greater Noida plant (Jalpura, PIN 201308) and delivered to North Delhi ready to use. Typical transit is 3–5 days once the unit is ready, and default delivery is ₹3,000 where applicable.

A single cabin is craned into place in a few hours and a multi-cabin layout is assembled on the spot. Tell us about access at your North Delhi location — gate width, room for a crane and the ground condition — and we plan the placement before dispatch so installation day is straightforward.

Factory-direct, not a reseller listing

Many North Delhi buyers start on directory and listing sites, where one enquiry is shared with several traders and the actual maker is hard to identify. With SAMAN you deal directly with the manufacturer: one point of contact, factory-direct pricing with no middle margin, a written specification, and a single team responsible for the build, delivery and after-sales support. Because we control the steel frame and the fit-out, we can tell you exactly what goes into your cabin.

What a portable office cabin costs in North Delhi

There is no single fixed price — the cost depends on the size, the number of rooms, insulation, flooring, electricals and air-conditioning, the exterior finish and your site access.

A basic single-room cabin costs less than a fully fitted, air-conditioned multi-room layout with premium flooring and branding. Because you buy directly from the manufacturer there is no dealer margin, and we return a written, itemised quote against your exact requirement so you can see what each part adds. We do not quote a price blind — share your plan and you get real numbers.

Why buy direct from SAMAN, the manufacturer

SAMAN POS India Private Limited builds these units in-house, so a North Delhi buyer deals with the maker rather than a reseller. We are an ISO 9001:2015 certified manufacturer, and each cabin carries a clear warranty: 5 years structural frame and base + 1–2 years finishing + 20–25 years engineered service life (the service life is an engineering estimate, not a warranty). Returns are accepted within 7 days of delivery or installation. You can see the full range, sizes and specifications on our portable office cabin range.

Why Buy Your Portable Office Cabin Factory-Direct from SAMAN

North Delhi’s Narela and Bawana Industrial Areas, the Wazirpur Industrial Area and the Azadpur belt (around PIN 110040) need portable office cabins for factory and warehouse site offices. SAMAN manufactures portable office cabins in-house on an IS 2062 steel frame at its Bangalore (Gopasandra 560099) and Greater Noida (201308) units, with 500+ projects delivered. Each office cabin is built to your size with insulated wall and roof panels, vinyl or laminate flooring, doors, windows and electrical points. Delivery is Rs 3,000 with 3–5 day transit. Warranty is 5 years structural frame and base + 1–2 years finishing + 20–25 years engineered service life. Call or WhatsApp +91 88616 22859, or send an enquiry, for a size-matched quote. Browse the full portable office range or our portable office cabin page.

NSIC/GP/BAN/2024/0055207, DPIIT recognised startup Ref. DIPP56005, Udyam registered UDYAM-KR-03-0172770, GST 29ABBCS7101B1ZR Bangalore and 09ABBCS7101B1ZT Noida.

FAQs: portable office cabins in North Delhi


How quickly can SAMAN deliver a portable office cabin in Rohini or Pitampura?

Each cabin is built new at our Greater Noida plant (Jalpura, PIN 201308). Typical transit is 3–5 days once the unit is ready, and default delivery is ₹3,000 where applicable. A single cabin is craned into place in a few hours.


What makes SAMAN's portable office cabins different?

We are the manufacturer, not a reseller, so you get factory-direct pricing, an IS 2062 steel frame, and a clear 5-year structural warranty.


What sizes are available?

Common sizes are 10×10 ft, 20×8 ft, 20×10 ft and 40×10 ft, used singly or joined into multi-room layouts with cabins, a meeting room and a washroom. We build to your floor plan.


How is the price decided?

Size, the number of rooms, insulation, flooring, electricals, air-conditioning, exterior finish and site access all affect the price. We quote against your exact specification — call +91 88616 22859 or use the enquiry form for a written quote.


What build quality and warranty do I get?

Each office uses an IS 2062 steel frame with insulated panels. The warranty is 5 years on the structural frame and base plus 1–2 years on finishing, and the engineered service life is 20–25 years (a service life, not a warranty).


Get a portable office cabin quote in North Delhi

Share your size, layout and site details and we will send a written quote with lead time for North Delhi — no obligation.

Call +91 88616 22859 or use our Send Enquiry form, and our team will help you choose the right cabin.
